ground_steward.text: No ball games on the pitch. Yes, I know it's a football ground. Rules is rules.

ground_city.text: Sir Stanley Matthews. Wizard of the Dribble. Played till he was fifty, knighted while still playing. They don't make them like that now.

ground_vale.text: I'm a Vale fan, I'm only here for the pie. And to be disappointed in a different postcode.
